sql.sql: SELECT "c"."active" AS "active", "c"."code" AS "code", "c"."concept_id" AS "concept_id", "c"."definition" AS "definition", "c"."display" AS "display" FROM "concept" "c" WHERE (("c"."cs_id" = @cs_id_2) AND ("c"."active" = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "found" FROM "closure" "cl" INNER JOIN (SELECT "c"."concept_id" AS "concept_id" FROM "concept" "c" WHERE (("c"."cs_id" = @cs_id_1) AND "c"."code" IN (@code_0))) "seed" ON ("cl"."ancestor_id" = "seed"."concept_id") WHERE ("cl"."descendant_id" = "c"."concept_id"))) ORDER BY "c"."code" ASC LIMIT 50

sql.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM "closure" "cl" INNER JOIN (SELECT "c"."concept_id" AS "concept_id" FROM "concept" "c" WHERE (("c"."cs_id" = @cs_id_1) AND "c"."code" IN (@code_0))) "seed" ON ("cl"."ancestor_id" = "seed"."concept_id") INNER JOIN "concept" "c" ON ("c"."concept_id" = "cl"."descendant_id") WHERE ("c"."active" = 1)
